title: Down Payment Terms of the Deferred Payment Agreements
content:
**Terms of the Agreement — Schedule A: Down Payment**
Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements), Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative

A.1 Each tier sets the down payment as a percent of the past-due amount, with a smallest down payment in US dollars that is never more than the past-due amount.

A.2 Each tier states whether an open energy assistance pledge counts toward the down payment.

A.3 The down payment may be paid through the channels listed for the tier.

| Tier | Down payment, percent of the past-due amount | Smallest down payment | Open energy assistance pledge counts toward the down payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement | 25 percent | $50.00 | no |
| Extended Hardship Payment Agreement | 10 percent | $25.00 | yes |
| Winter Protection Payment Agreement | 10 percent | $25.00 | yes |
| Medical Certificate Payment Agreement | 0 percent | $0.00 | yes |
| Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement | 20 percent | $250.00 | no |
| Commercial Installment Agreement | 50 percent | $250.00 | no |

**Down payment channels.** Every tier accepts the down payment through the same eight channels: online card, online electronic check, phone (IVR) card, office cash, office check, money order, payment kiosk, and energy assistance agency.

**Reading Schedule A**

- The Medical Certificate Payment Agreement asks for no down payment: its percent and its smallest amount are both zero.
- The Commercial Installment Agreement carries the highest percent on the schedule, 50 percent, with a $250.00 smallest amount; the Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement shares the $250.00 smallest amount at 20 percent.
- A check presented at a district office is paid through the office check channel; a card payment made over the automated phone line is paid through the phone (IVR) card channel.
